title: The Sampling Distribution of the Log-Euclidean Distance Between Sample Correlation Matrices
summary: Comparing correlation matrices across time or stress scenarios is critical in quantitative finance and multivariate statistics, yet sample estimation noise often obscures whether an observed distance reflects a true structural shift. We derive the asymptotic sampling distribution of the intrinsic off-log (log-Euclidean) distance between two independently estimated full-rank correlation matrices under the null hypothesis that their population correlation matrices coincide.
